cards.title: Where the distance comes from
items: Every sample is an android.ranging.RangingData delivered by the platform for the peer you named
The sample carries a distance, a confidence of low, medium or high, an optional RSSI and a timestamp; any of them can be missing, and a missing one is null
The platform does not say whether phase-based ranging or round-trip time produced a sample, so the hook reports no method

cards.title: When nothing is measured
items: No peer address, Bluetooth off, a missing android.permission.RANGING or an unsupported device each resolve startRanging with a named status in sessionError
A peer that never answers leaves measurements empty, which means no peer answered rather than a distance of zero
supportedSecurityLevels lists what the device reports; a level it does not list is refused before a session is opened
